about: The public halves of this site's agents' session keys: id, fingerprints, and where the public bundle is (team/keys/, the only place the leak scan allows public keys). Never a private key, a token or a contact detail.

keys.tool: sgit-ai v0.27.0 (sgit pki keygen), as conductor.b@'s brief says, following Dinis's word of 18 Nov 2026 (~15:10 UTC, Website board/guidance/2026-11-18-keys-issues-rebuilds-observability.md)

gap: The private half stays in this session's container, protected by a passphrase kept beside it outside the repository (never committed, never printed); it lives only as long as this container. Not yet registered on pki.sgit.ai. Git commits are not signed with it (git cannot use an sgit key); instead each release commits a manifest of every tracked file's sha256 signed with it (scripts/sign-release.sh, board/team/videos/signed/; check with sgit pki verify).
